label: Contingent-support rival of the no-contingent-support premise survives, checked
meaning: Rival test for the no-contingent-support premise against its smallest consumer, NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks (premises: concrete population, well-founded actual grounding, contingent dependence, reflexive access at the selected world, no contingent concrete support, well-founded union of necessary support, excluded middle). With a necessary whole that is a root at the selected world and is grounded at another world by a part existing only there, the rival holds with the other six premises and no necessary concretum is underived at every admitted world. Model-witnessed survival only.
